note: Saudi Arabia: the other GCC states' citizens move freely; Russia's ordinary passports enter without a visa for 90 days in a calendar year since 11 May 2026 (the calendar-year count isn't modelled); British citizens may use the electronic visa waiver (single entry, up to 6 months); holders of the passports listed get a tourist e-Visa online or on arrival, for stays of up to 90 days. Everyone else needs a visa (holders of a used US, UK or Schengen visa may get the e-Visa on arrival: not modelled). Read from Wikipedia's copy of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs' and the Visit Saudi rules. Checked on 2026-11-03 against the Saudi eVisa portal's list of eligible countries (90 days a visit), which confirmed the e-Visa list but for Taiwan, which isn't on it and was moved to a visa; Russia's visa-free entry, the British electronic waiver and the GCC rule aren't stated there and stand on Wikipedia's copy.
